t: Wood bow saw with powder-coated steel frame and ultra sharp triple ground hard-point teeth. Features an easy blade tensioner to keep blade taut during usage to ensure accurate cutting. Also includes an ergonomic soft grip handle with knuckle protection for additional comfort. Ideal for trimming live trees, branches and shrubbery without clogging. Replacement blades and dry blades are available, simply switch out the blade to cut dead and dry wood.
